purpose: Fresh publication-grade efficiency measurement of frozen Full-S1 vs frozen K1. No training, no TEST access, no Q8, no change to any frozen predictive artifact.

model_pair_selection.rationale: Efficiency is an architectural property. The cell is fixed by a deterministic rule recorded before measurement, never chosen from efficiency outcomes.

Full-S1.load: checkpoint['model'] with the 'core.' prefix stripped, strict=True; heads from checkpoint['heads']

architectures.heads: src.methodology_v2.experiment.heads.DatasetHeads (identical class and parameter count for both models)

inputs.source: frozen global fold manifest global_v2_fold_1.csv, split == 'validation' only
inputs.rule: first VALIDATION window per dataset in frozen manifest order

hardware.gpu_query: NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada Generation, 580.126.09, 20475 MiB, P8, Enabled, 3105 MHz, 130.00 W

gpu.timer: time.perf_counter with torch.cuda.synchronize() around each timed region
gpu.timer_rationale: preserves the synchronized host-timing method of the historical Part-6 harness (_time_forward); CUDA events are not substituted

throughput.rule: identical batch size for both models; not tuned per model

schedule_deviation_from_historical.historical: warmup=5, timed=20, batches (1,16) CPU / (16,64) GPU, threads (1,4)
schedule_deviation_from_historical.adopted: warmup=100/200, timed=1000, batch 1 primary, batch 32 throughput, threads=1
schedule_deviation_from_historical.reason: The requested publication schedule is strictly stronger (50x more timed samples). The historical schedule was not preserved because it is weaker, and batch-1 single-thread is the deployment-facing primary here.

scopes.model_only: prepared resident representation -> encoder -> dataset head -> logits
scopes.end_to_end: resident raw 1 s waveform -> stft_rep (log1p|STFT|) -> N2b normalisation -> collate -> encoder -> head -> logits
scopes.disk_io: excluded from both scopes: the waveform is resident in memory and the normaliser lru_cache is warmed before timing

measurement.order_control: ABAB interleaving within one process: for each dataset and scope, rounds alternate Full-S1 / K1 so thermal and load drift affect both models equally. Round count and per-round sample count recorded in the raw CSV.

aggregation.primary_headline: equal-domain mean of the four per-dataset medians (no weighting by sample count)

measurement.rerun_policy: A completed valid measurement is never repeated. Only infrastructure-invalid runs may be repeated, and the reason must be recorded.

dense_term.convention: 2 x MAC for matrix products (PyTorch FlopCounterMode default)
dense_term.note: This term alone is NOT the total: it does not count the selective-scan recurrence.

scan_term.method: analytic, preserved from the historical Part-6 harness analytic_scan_flops
scan_term.formula: scan_flops = batch * n_bands * (sum over layers of directions) * T * d_inner * d_state * C
scan_term.C_meaning: approximate elementary flops per (d_inner x d_state) state element per sequential step for h_t = exp(dt A) h_{t-1} + (dt B) x_t ; y_t = C h_t
scan_term.C_sensitivity: A strict per-operation tally of the reference scan gives about 8 rather than 6, which would scale the scan term by 4/3. The historical constant is preserved; because the identical constant applies to both models, the Full-S1/K1 ratio is unaffected.
scan_term.n_bands_and_T: derived empirically from the actual patch grid of each dataset's representation, NOT hardcoded
scan_term.directions: Full-S1 = 2 per layer (BiMambaLayer), K1 = 1 per layer (UniMambaLayer); the same formula covers both

flop_convention.total: total_flops = dense_term + scan_term, reported explicitly as that sum and never as a profiler total alone
flop_convention.reporting_unit: per one 1-second window, per dataset, plus the equal-domain Macro-4 mean

historical_implementation_not_used_verba.reason: Its DATASET_SHAPES and n_bands are bound to the dissertation-era representation. It assumes CWRU (513, 184) with 33 frequency bands, whereas the publication CWRU native-12 kHz representation is (129, 184) with 9 bands. Using it unchanged would overstate CWRU scan cost by 33/9 for BOTH models. The counting convention is preserved; only the input parameterisation is taken from the live model.

size_convention.serialized_state_dict: torch.save of a state_dict-only FP32 payload to a temporary file, identical procedure for both models, measured in bytes; temporary files deleted after measurement and never added to Git
size_convention.note: Training-checkpoint file sizes are NOT compared: checkpoint packaging differs between the two training stacks.
size_convention.q8: NOT measured. size_axis() in the historical harness calls apply_q8_simulated(); it is deliberately not used because Q8 must not be run.

memory_convention.method: each model measured in its own clean subprocess; torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats() then synchronize; record allocated after model load, peak allocated during forward, and the increment
memory_convention.validity_rule: reported as a headline claim only if the two clean-process measurements are self-consistent on repeat; otherwise labelled exploratory

prohibitions_observed: no modification of frozen TEST artifacts
no modification of K1 training artifacts
no reuse of dissertation-era efficiency numbers as publication results
no modification of the dissertation repository
no edit of historical benchmark source
